name: Plot Yangu
audience: Landlords, property agents, managers and caretakers
description: Properties, units, tenants, invoices and M-Pesa rent in one dashboard. Works offline on web, Android and desktop.
longDescription: Plot Yangu is a property management app for landlords and property agents in Kenya. It keeps properties, units, tenants, invoices and M-Pesa payments in one dashboard, stores your data on your device first so it works offline, and syncs across devices in the cloud on paid plans. Landlord Watch gives landlords of agent-managed properties a read-only view of their rent on WhatsApp or the web, and House to Rent lists vacant units for people searching by area on WhatsApp.
problem: Rent tracking, arrears, expenses and tenant messages are scattered, so owners rarely see the true financial picture of their properties.
features: PDF invoices, including water and power readings
M-Pesa rent collection, matched to the right invoice
Automatic tenant messages: SMS first, WhatsApp backup for tenants who opted in
Landlord Watch: landlords of agent-managed properties see rent collected, pending and payable on WhatsApp or the web
House to Rent: vacant units listed for people searching by area on WhatsApp, with SMS inquiries to the manager
Excel and PDF exports and reports
Your own logo on invoices (Business and above)
Works offline, data stored on your device
Web app, Android app and Windows, macOS and Linux desktop apps
steps: Add a property. Everything saves to your device first, so it works with no signal.
Add tenants to units, with their phone numbers for invoices and messages.
Generate invoices in a few taps, each with a downloadable PDF.
Tenants pay by M-Pesa and payments are matched to the invoice automatically.
Invoice, payment and overdue messages go out by SMS, with WhatsApp as backup.

connects: Tenants pay rent through Samuhia Payments, and approved Samuhia Desk agents can support landlords and collect rent on their behalf. Landlord Watch and House to Rent extend Plot Yangu to landlords and house hunters on WhatsApp.

faq.a: Landlords and property agents in Kenya, including managers and caretakers.
Yes. Properties, tenants and invoices are stored on your device first. On Solo and above, data also syncs across your devices when you are online.

faq.q: What does the free trial include?
faq.a: New accounts get 3 months of Business free, with no card needed: cloud sync, your logo on invoices, arrears tracking and Excel and PDF export.
Yes. New invoices, payment confirmations and overdue reminders go out by SMS first, with WhatsApp as a backup for tenants who opted in.

faq.q: How do I pay for a plan?
faq.a: By M-Pesa. You get a prompt on your phone and confirm with your PIN. Payments are processed through Paystack.

Landlord Watch lets a landlord whose property is managed by an agency see rent billed, collected and pending, the agent's commission, the net amount payable and who has paid, on WhatsApp or the web. It is read-only, and tenant details stay hidden until the landlord unlocks them with a one-time SMS code.

House to Rent lets people search for vacant units by area on WhatsApp and send an inquiry to the property manager by SMS. Units marked vacant in Plot Yangu are listed automatically for properties synced to the cloud.
